items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: That was important because that's where I met Red and Mildred

ctx.x: Why don't we go back to Charlie Barnet.
That was important because that's where I met Red and Mildred, (phonetic spelling). Red was always running away from Mildred; I guess it had a tendency to be sparkling, that marriage.
